_note: Global site config and outbound links.
_blogPublic_note: false = blog built but unlisted, noindexed, excluded from sitemap and nav. Flip to true to revive publicly.
_signupUrl_note: Active delegate sign-up form. Until supplied, the Get Involved CTA renders disabled with a 'Applications opening soon' state — never a dead link.
_recruitmentOpen_note: Drives the Get Involved / home CTA. true = show sign-up form link. false = show mailing list signup instead. Single toggle, no code change.
_mailingListUrl_note: HubSpot hosted share link for the newsletter — the delegate waitlist while recruitmentOpen is false. Must stay a hosted page we link out to: .htaccess sets form-action and connect-src to 'self', so a HubSpot embed snippet or on-site POST would be blocked by CSP.
_incidentFormUrl_note: Both languages point at the same form — the Google Form is English-only. Must stay the published /forms/d/e/<long-id>/ URL from Send > <>, never a /forms/d/<doc-id>/ one: the doc-id variant leaks the editable document ID into public page source.
_incidentFormAnonymous_note: True because Settings > Responses > 'Collect email addresses' is Off (re-verified 2026-08-18) and the Form does not require sign-in. Re-check after any Form settings change — /report promises anonymity off this flag.

instagramEmbed._note: Latest on Instagram widget on home. See phase-2b spec for approach options.
